correctness.rationale: The normalized weighted monomial norms give the stated kernel prefactor. Exact hypergeometric Euler/Pfaff identities produce the Jacobi numerator, whose m simple real roots are negative. The strictly positive parameter-derivative integral is derived from orthogonality of divided monic polynomials. Legendre parity and coefficient asymptotics prove exactly floor(m/2) distinct simple positive parameter thresholds and the boundary exclusion at t=-1. Standard orthonormal Jacobi recurrence plus Gershgorin/Rayleigh proves the limiting endpoint h(c) and the sharp ratio 2+2sqrt(2). Laguerre coefficient convergence proves the fixed-m root scaling. Direct packaged CHECK.py execution passed 383 checks; finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise number of attainable Gram-kernel zeros is a natural complete invariant for weighted pure-jet evaluation geometry; changing the weight produces genuine algebraic phase transitions. The result gives all finite transition weights at every order and a sharp universal large-order weight/jet ratio, with high-weight root locations. It is neither a narrow arbitrary computation nor a restatement of the fixed unweighted count.
